description: The bar chart illustrates average performance values for three methods, with each method shown as a stacked bar separating a “Standard” component from an “Ours” component. The category axis is horizontal with three labeled positions (leftmost unlabeled method, then “CORG,” then “AdaCAD”), and the value axis is vertical labeled “Average Performance,” using a linear scale from 48 to 62 with regularly spaced tick marks every 2 units and dashed horizontal gridlines. Each stacked bar uses gray for “Standard” and blue for “Ours,” as indicated by the legend in the upper-left. The leftmost bar appears to have no visible gray “Standard” segment (approximately 0 height for that component) and a blue “Ours” segment reaching to about 59.2. The “CORG” bar has a gray “Standard” segment rising to about 51.5 and a blue “Ours” segment stacked above it up to about 59.5. The “AdaCAD” bar has a gray “Standard” segment rising to about 53.4 and a blue “Ours” segment stacked above it up to about 60.1. The bars are not shown with explicit sorting cues beyond their left-to-right placement, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the color coding and stacking.
